_meta._note: Set _global_status to 'active' only after all binding sections are populated and approved. While 'inactive', BGA runs in advisory-only mode and never blocks the pipeline.
_meta.source_reference: TBD — populate from approved Version 2 visual direction reference

identity._description: The foundational character of the channel's visual presence. All other sections derive from this.

color_system._description: The definitive color palette for all visual outputs. Period palettes (defined per-episode by VPD) must harmonise with this system — they cannot contradict it.

thumbnail_palette._note: Thumbnail color may diverge from primary palette for CTR — but must remain within these bounds.

period_palette_constraints._note: Episode-specific period palettes (Hellenistic, Victorian, etc.) must not use colors in the forbidden list.

typography._description: Font system for all text elements: thumbnails, Shorts overlays, chapter cards, lower thirds. No font outside this system may appear in any output.

thumbnail_language._description: Rules governing how main episode thumbnails must be composed. Thumbnail Director is bound by these rules. CTR-based overrides require explicit per-episode approval.

face_rules._note: Whether human faces appear in thumbnails, and if so, under what conditions.

documentary_visual_grammar._description: Permanent rules governing how scenes are composed for this documentary-format channel. These rules are already active in the VPD system prompt. This section formalises them in the Bible for BGA enforcement.

forbidden_visual_modes._note: These are permanent and cannot be overridden by any agent, prompt, or config flag.

documentary_visual_grammar.motion_rule: All figures must derive motion from physical action, not from speech or facial expression.
documentary_visual_grammar.narration_model: Voice-over only. Narration is always audio-only. Visuals support narration; they never depict it.
documentary_visual_grammar.person_speaking_substitution_rule: When a narration beat references a person speaking, substitute with: the artefact they referenced, the environment where they spoke, or their physical action. Document substitution as CAPABILITY_LIMITED only if narrative intent is materially lost.

motion_language._description: The vocabulary of camera and subject motion that is on-register for this channel. VPD must assign motion_type values from this vocabulary.

logo_system._description: Channel mark and logo usage rules. Applies to thumbnails, end cards, channel art, and any branded element in video output.

iconography._description: Visual iconography and symbolic language on-register for this channel. Not binding until populated — current episodes derive iconography from historical period accuracy.

forbidden_patterns._description: Exhaustive list of visual patterns permanently prohibited across all agents and all outputs. These cannot be overridden by any flag, prompt, or config. Add to this list; never remove.

social_media_rules._description: Platform-specific visual rules for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok. Governs aspect ratio handling, title card design, and platform-specific forbidden elements.

shorts_rules._description: Visual rules specific to Shorts/vertical format content. These apply regardless of whether Shorts are generated as dedicated scenes or extracted from the main episode master.
shorts_rules.redirect_text_rule: Silent text overlay only. Maximum 7 words. Drive to full episode. Not promotional copy.
shorts_rules._generation_model_note: Will be set to 'extracted' once Shorts extraction architecture (M6) is implemented. Until then, 'disabled' (ENABLE_DEDICATED_SHORT_GENERATION=false).

publishing_rules._description: Brand compliance rules for publishing metadata and disclosures.
